portraits.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. PRODUCTION DIALOGUE PORTRAIT ATLAS for the hand-painted dwarf game The Stellar Holds. Exactly SIX square chest-up portraits in a strict evenly spaced 3-column x 2-row grid, 1536x1024. No text, labels, panels, borders, hands, tools or extra figures. Each face and entire hair stays INSIDE its own 512px square with 8% headroom, shoulders reach cell bottom. Solid uniform deep desaturated teal background #283f45 in every cell. NO transparency needed. Camera and head size consistent. Bold warm dark outlines, clear large painted color blocks, only 2-3 main values, restrained soft shading. Much simpler than detailed concept art. Readable at 86px square! No tiny ornament or textures. Normal adult eyes, strong distinct noses/jaws/brows, not anime/chibi/photoreal. All men fully bearded over chin and jaw; all women unbearded and attractive sturdy adult dwarves. Natural fixed hair colors. Preserve approved character identity but simplify. References are identity and style guides; do not copy layouts or names into image. Top left DAGNA: warm heart-shaped face, chestnut loose waves, red bodice with cream scoop neck/short sleeves, affectionate subtle smile, medium shoulders. Top middle RAGNHILD: athletic feminine pear build, longer oval face and straight nose, copper crown braid, green sleeveless square-neck dress, steady relaxed smile. Top right BRYNJA: compact athletic square shoulders, angular attractive face with short strong nose, flaxen side braid, ochre open sleeveless shirt/dark leather apron, focused half-smile. Bottom left ORLA: mature broader shoulders, full-busted defined waist, visibly longer prominent nose and broad cheekbones distinct from Ragnhild, copper braided LOW BUN, blue V-neck dress/elbow sleeves, kindly confident expression. Bottom middle EDDA: narrow upright frame, mature long face, arched nose, spectacles, ash-brown hair with silver streak/low braided bun, blue waistcoat over cream open collar, calm attentive expression. Bottom right SIGRID: broad muscular shoulders/strong upper arms, square feminine jaw, strong straight brows, black side braid with copper band, slate blue sleeveless tunic, assured expression.
